nodes.title: How can we help with your order?
answers: Something is wrong with my order
I want to return or exchange
I want to change or cancel

nodes.title: Did you receive a shipping confirmation email?
Track your package
nodes.text: Open the tracking link in your shipping email. Tracking can take up to 24 hours to show the first scan. If it has not moved for 5 business days, contact us with your order number.

nodes.title: How long ago did you place the order?
Your order is being prepared
nodes.text: Orders usually ship within 1 to 2 business days. You will get an email with tracking as soon as it leaves our warehouse.

nodes.title: Check your spam folder, then contact us
nodes.text: Shipping emails sometimes land in spam or promotions. If you cannot find it, send us your order number and we will check it for you.

nodes.title: Send us a photo
nodes.text: Sorry about that. Reply to your order confirmation with a photo of the item and the packaging, and we will send a replacement or a refund.

nodes.title: We will fix it
nodes.text: Please do not throw anything away. Send us your order number and a photo of what you received, and we will send the right item with a free return label.

nodes.title: Check for a second package
nodes.text: Large orders sometimes ship in more than one box. Check your shipping email for multiple tracking numbers. If everything has arrived and an item is still missing, contact us.

nodes.title: Is it within 30 days of delivery?
Start your return
nodes.text: Items in original condition can be returned within 30 days. Use our returns page to print a label.

nodes.title: Contact us about late returns
nodes.text: Our standard return window is 30 days, but we review every case. Send us your order number and the reason.

nodes.title: Contact us quickly
nodes.text: We can change or cancel an order only before it ships. Email us as soon as possible with your order number.
